Some time later, the man, who has fallen in love with the girl, sends her abroad to have her blind eyes treated...

title: Emanet
overview: Kadir, who has been affected by the internal conflict in the underworld, sends his daughter Zehra to Istanbul to stay with her old friend Murat. The conflict continues, but Zehra is now in Murat's care.

title: The Profiteers
overview: The story of two profiteers, Kont and Cessi, captures a valuable diamond causing the mafia go after them.

title: Gönül Meyhanesi
overview: Gönül meyhanesi tells the story of a young college student (Demir Karahan), living with his sick mother. One night he gets involved in a car accident and loses his sight. The driver (Belgin Doruk) feels guilty about this incident and suffers.

title: Miracles Of Love
overview: During the 1960s, a disabled man finds himself in an arranged marriage to the most beautiful girl in the village.

title: The Broken Lifes
overview: Married couple move to a new house. Thanks to this new house they climb the social ladder. At the same time troubles are started.

title: Dağlar Şahini
overview: Sahin works as a farmer for Hidir Aga. Sahin is in love with Zeynep who is fancied by Hidir's son Suleyman, too. Enmity comes to exist between Sahin and Hidir Aga. Hidir denounces him to the gendarme chief Hasan. Yet Hasan believes Sahin and sets him free. Hidir urges Zeynep to get engaged with his son. Sahin kidnaps Zeynep. Suleyman and his men follow them, Zeynep kills Suleyman. Hidir and his men are after them now. They find their trace. Zeynep gets injured in the fight and dies. Now, the time has come for Sahin to take revenge and death is inevitable.

title: Last House in Istanbul
overview: Three criminals on the run, breaking into the house of a wealthy doctor and his hot wife ...

title: Tatlım
overview: Ferit and Alev are the children of two wealthy families, and their families want them to marry. However, Ferit is very spoiled and promiscuous. On top of that, he looks down on Alev. When Alev goes to the farm to meet him and learns that Ferit is in Istanbul, she goes to Istanbul in a completely different guise to take revenge on him.

title: Kayıp Kızlar
overview: Young, beautiful, and innocent girls from different economic and social backgrounds, who share similar problems, fall into the hands of the prostitution mafia and are forced into a life of endless shame. They are subjected to inhumane treatment. Lale, a college graduate, is the most beautiful among them. Escaping her stepfather's abuse, Lale seeks refuge at her school friend Nesli's house. She mistakes Nesli for a model and wants to pursue the same career. Nesli introduces her to a man named Reşit. Reşit drugs Lale, rapes her, films the act, and then blackmails her into prostitution.

title: Emine, The Leaning One
overview: Ömer Kavur's first film Yatik Emine (Emine, The Leaning One), relates the story, set in the years of World War I, of a prostitute exiled in a small town.

title: Winter Sleep
overview: Aydın is a hotel owner and a retired actor in rural Turkey. As winter emerges he begins navigating the conflicts within the relationships with his wife, sister and existence.

title: Cingöz Recai
overview: Cingöz Recai, recently released from prison, plans a new robbery. Together with his men, he robs the house of merchant Selim Bey. Upon learning of the robbery, Commissioner Mehmet Rıza goes after Recai. During the robbery, Recai takes a liking to Selim Bey's stepdaughter, Selma. He notices there is a problem between Selma and her father. He follows Selma and sees that she is in trouble. While trying to protect Selma from the men chasing her, he learns a secret code that Selma knows. Recai, who is fleeing the police, will also try to decipher the code.

title: Yumurtanın Sarısı
overview: A mild-mannered produce vendor Kamil falls under the spell of Emel, a nightclub striptease performer working to support her disabled child, after a chance encounter at a local watering hole.

title: Yarın Ağlayacağım
overview: A man whose life is in difficulties becomes a prosecutor, but he has problems with his wife due to a wrong marriage, and in the meantime he gets close to a journalist.

title: Kader Utansın
overview: A small-town mechanic, Tamer, fixes the car of two women stranded on the road; afterward, one invites him to perform at the city nightclub where he struggles to adapt to the urban lifestyle.

title: Unutulmayanlar
overview: Fahrettin, Ekrem, Fikret, İzzet, Nejat, Orhan and Eşref work as truck drivers for a company. Guns are loaded into their trucks without their knowledge. They are smuggling weapons without their knowledge. The police seize the trucks in a raid. The drivers, who are informed about the raid via radio, manage to escape at the last moment. In order to prove their innocence, they decide to find the company owner, Lebanese Manukyan. On their journey, they will also come to terms with their past.

title: The Magician
overview: Failed magician Iskender decides to do a tour to save his career, but has to bring his grumpy and senile father along. The tour is quite unexpectedly interrupted when a bride actually disappears from the stage.

title: The Flying Meatball Maker
overview: Kadir, a meatball maker, father of three and native of Diyarbakır, is determined to fly, and he won’t let tradition, his family, the state and his troublesome paramotor stop him from trying. Because while paying the price of freedom. what matters is maintaining hope against all odds.

title: Keriz
overview: Zülfü and Zülfiye get married. However, Abbas, Zülfü's uncle, who is trying to take over Zülfü's property, tries to separate the couple. Abbas spreads rumors about Zülfiye. He incites Zülfü to kill his wife. Eventually, Zülfiye secretly moves to Istanbul with her family. Zülfü goes to Istanbul to kill Zülfiye, influenced by his uncle's persuasion. However, when a mine is discovered on Zülfiye's father's land, all plans will change.

title: Belalı Torun
overview: Captain Bey's only dream is to have a grandson. His daughter Bedriye knows this and therefore she keeps her daughter Kamuran away from her father for years, raising her in Europe.

title: Berduş
overview: Kemal and Nuri are two friends who make a living as street vendors. They live together in a house they rent from Mrs. Mualla. The two friends' business is not going well. Their customers are not satisfied with their goods. On top of that, they are in trouble with the police. They cannot pay the rent because they cannot make ends meet. Moreover, they now need even more money. They have become friends with two cousins they rescued from drowning. Nermin and her cousin are impressed by Kemal and Nuri’s sincerity. Their friendship is growing. The two friends are too ashamed to mention their financial difficulties, so they don’t let it show. However, things are getting increasingly complicated.

title: Son Adam
overview: The story of a man who takes revenge for his wife, who was murdered by his closest friend.

title: Güneş Doğarken
overview: Nalan, who comes to work at a brothel in Konya, begins a love affair with Kara Davut, the city's notorious gangster. Kara Davut, who receives no attention from his wife at home, and Nalan, who has never experienced true love and affection, begin a relationship that soon becomes the talk of Konya, and it isn't long before things start to get complicated.

title: Muhteşem Serseri
overview: Naci is a daring journalist who has gained fame under the name Muhteşem Serseri (The Magnificent Tramp). He is particularly interested in celebrity news. This gives him plenty of opportunities to flirt. Tired of Naci's tramping, his boss gives him a chance to show off his skills. He will soon be interviewing an Arab princess who is coming to Istanbul. However, up until this point, no photographs of the princess have been taken, and no information about her has been obtained. Naci learns where the princess will be staying through his assistant Nuri. However, no one could have anticipated that the queen, who wants to ensure her daughter's safety, would play a trick.

title: Losers' Club
overview: Kaan and Mete, co-hosts of a mid 1990s radio show called Kaybedenler Kulübü (Losers' Club), struggle to deal with their daily lives after their show becomes an instant hit. Kaan meets Zeynep, the girl of his dreams, but their relationship comes under pressure as the show continues to stir controversy and attract fans from every segment of Istanbul society.

title: Government Woman 2
overview: Seven years before the first film, Xate, still living in her husband Aziz Veysel’s shadow, is about to become the region’s first female mayor when a routine morning send-off for Aziz turns explosive, reigniting the fierce rivalry between Xate and the power-hungry Faruk. Their conflict escalates further when there’s an unexpected call for snap elections.

title: Görünmeyen Düşman
overview: The story of a police chief. The police chief, who has a tough but honest personality, marries the girl he loves. Some time later, it turns out that his father-in-law is a leading member of a mafia gang. The police chief goes after his father-in-law. Because of this incident, the happy life between the police chief and his wife turns into various conflicts, but in the end, everything works out.

title: The Other
overview: A successful man leads a happy life with his new lover Ece. But one day, the ambitious old lover Sara, joins her life again with a job offer that she can not refuse. The man who changed his city for his new job by taking his lover Ece with him is soon to be destroyed by the disappearance of Ece.

title: No Way
overview: A Turkish taxi driver tells stories which are almost unbelievable.

title: Baş Belası
overview: A dorky uncle and a nag of an aunt mess up a family, their surroundings and ultimately half of Venice. Ein an Schwachsinn grenzender Klamauk, von allen guten Geistern verlassen. Baba is a disgraced gang leader! He threatens everyone and collects "protection money". Recently another gangster called Riza appeared. He uses Baba's name and collects the money in his name. Baba tries everything to stop him but fails. Riza falls in love with Aisha, who turns out to be Baba's daughter. He blackmails Baba to marry his daughter. Baba's man Bekir hatches a plot on his behalf and kidnaps Ayşe. Baba and Reza save him, Baba forgives Bekir and gives his place to Reza. Now he will spend time with his grandchildren...

title: Time of Happiness
overview: True love is not about perfection, it is hidden in flaws. The movie 'Mutluluk Zamani' (Time of Happiness) tells the story of Mert (Baris Arduc) who creates his 'perfect' life without facing his past and Ada (Elcin Sangu) who builds her own way of life based on all of her past experiences.

title: Kiralık Koca
overview: Her father does everything he can to help Gül, who is confined to a wheelchair as a result of a traffic accident, to walk again. The only way for Gül to walk again is to give birth and go through shock. Gül's father makes an agreement with lawyer Ali for him to become Gül's husband. Orhan, Gül's father's secretary, also plans to marry Gül in order to inherit her fortune. Gül and Ali's happiness will not last as long as they had planned.

title: Kumarbazın İntikamı
overview: Murat was very young when his parents separated. He left his father's mansion with his mother and never saw him again. However, this distance does not prevent him from suspecting his father's suicide. As far as he knows, his father is not the type of person who would commit suicide. He believes there is a secret behind this. The old man, before his suicide, had lost his mansion—his last remaining asset—at the gambling table where he sat for the last time. Before dying, he wrote four names on three gambling cards, leaving behind unanswered questions. Murat will set out to uncover the meaning of this clue, whose significance he does not yet understand.

title: Zengin ve Serseri
overview: Ekrem hits a man with his car. The man refuses to go to the hospital, saying he is fine. However, he dies three days later. His wife, who is devastated by her husband's death, also dies. The family's daughter, Mine, is left alone. Dudu, who leads young and helpless girls astray, tricks Mine into singing at a tavern. Upon learning all this, Ekrem disguises himself and goes to the neighborhood where the tavern is located to rescue Mine. He is confronted by Malik, who is angry with him for not telling him about the municipality's new projects.

title: Mustafa
overview: The biography of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, who not only grew himself up from a poor lonely child to a country's most loved person, but also rose a new country from the ashes of an empire. A story of a soldier, an eminent statesman and a great reformist.

title: Cevriyem
overview: A robber who carries out a bank robbery is sought everywhere, and the thief seeks shelter in Cevriye's house, seeking help from her. In time, a relationship will arise between the two that rebelled against all life and identities.

title: How to Save Asiye
overview: After receiving a letter from a woman named Asiye asking for help to save her, the President of the Associations Against Prostitution visits the brothel to save Asiye. However, she finds herself in a strange musical show.

title: Korkusuz Kabadayı
overview: The leader of a criminal organization, Ulvi, is shot dead by an unknown assailant. His will is opened. He has left his inheritance and leadership to his friend Fikret, on condition that the killer is found within a week.

title: After Years
overview: Berna, who lost her parents in a traffic accident on a stormy night, is traumatized. Doctors tell Berna, who is struggling to cope with the pain of losing her family, that a change of air will be good.

title: Steam: The Turkish Bath
overview: Francesco and Marta run a husband-and-wife design company in Rome. When Francesco's aunt dies in Istanbul he travels there to sort out the hamam Turkish steam bath that she left him. He finds a love and warmth in his relatives' Istanbul home that is missing from his life in Italy.

title: Have You Ever Seen Fireflies?
overview: Rebellious, irreverent wunderkind Gülseren navigates loneliness, love and loss against the current of political turmoil and social change.

title: İstanbul 79
overview: The life story of a family who migrated from a small town in Anatolia to Istanbul. Ömer from the family runs a gas cylinder dealership in the big city. Meanwhile, he gets involved in dirty business with a friend. Having severed ties with his family, Ömer cannot extricate himself from these shady dealings, even if he wanted to. He continues to live his life amidst Istanbul's vibrant and shadowy nightlife.

title: Ezo Gelin
overview: Feyzi Tuna's 1973 adaptation (the first in color) of the famous legend of Ezo the Bride, a real person who lived in the south eastern part of Turkey, close to Syrian border, in early 20th century.

title: Fight
overview: Kemal, a well-known bully, confronts Kasif, who manages the drug traffic and wants to do business in Turkey, and others, who want to do cocaine business with him.

title: Keşif
overview: Esma, Berk and Hasan are three people who try to escape the troubles of life with the help of a video game called Discovery. These three young people is sucked into the game in a mystical way. They find themselves in the battle of Gallipoli.

title: Wild Bride
overview: A man who wants to raise his daughter, Aysegul, away from modern life moves to a mountain with his daughter. One day a handsome, bankrupt man comes to mountains. Aysegul falls for him, which led her to join the corrupt modern life.

title: Because of Loving
overview: Idil, a wedding dress designer, finds herself caught in a conflict involving her ex-boyfriend and a bride's impending marriage. As she navigates this situation, she grapples with her own past and the complexities of relationships.

title: Peace with Life
overview: The story of Barış Telli, who suffered an unfortunate accident at a young age and, through his intense struggle after the accident, became not only a member of the Amputee Football National Team but also one of the most inspiring athletes in the country's history.

title: Bekar Odası
overview: Kazim works at a gas station, he wants to marry Iffet though her mother is against it, so she informs the police as they try to run away. The police is after Kazim since he inherited a fortune. Kazim starts living in a hotel suite, the singer Leyla makes a plot with her boss Cemil to get Kazim's money.

title: Tarkan and the Silver Saddle
overview: Atilla the Hun gives a Silver Saddle to Altar as a gift. The intention of Kostok is the get rid of the Huns and seize the valuable saddle. Little Tarkan's foster mother is forced to leave him in a cave.  His cry attracts the attention of a wolf, who raises Tarkan like his own cub.

title: Canikom
overview: The film tells the story of two lovers who find each other. Fikret is a womanizer who works as a manager at a company. He is engaged to Serap, the daughter of the company's owner. He goes to Şile on his yacht for a vacation. Bahar is a model. She has come to Şile for a photo shoot. Bahar and Fikret grow closer as a series of coincidences unfold. They plan to continue their love through marriage. However, Serap's unexpected arrival in Şile to surprise Fikret turns everything upside down. Fikret must now choose between leaving Serap and proving to Bahar how much he loves her.

title: My Love, My Sorrow
overview: The legendary love story of Ferhat and Sirin.

title: Love of Giant
overview: Reunion of two former lovers brings the end to the society they are part of through hate through revenge and through bloodshed, especially when the lovers were obliged to stand against their associates and families.

title: Gelinlik Kızlar
overview: The story of a woman who goes to prison to protect her family and a father left alone with his three daughters. You will witness the girls' sometimes comical, sometimes dramatic attempts to prevent their father from remarrying.

title: Tokat
overview: The film tells the story of a young girl who wants to take revenge on her father's killers. Banu, the daughter of a wealthy factory owner, has an accident one day. She hits a woman named Gamze with her car. Banu takes care of Gamze until she recovers. During this time, a close friendship develops between the two women. Meanwhile, Banu's father, Tarık Bey, also becomes emotionally close to Gamze, and this closeness quickly turns into marriage. At the same time, Tarık Bey is in conflict with the mafia over a bidding war. Tarık Bey, who is fleeing from the mafia's henchmen, is helped by a taxi driver named Fikret. Tarık Bey hires Fikret to work for him. However, Fikret meets Tarık Bey's wife, Gamze. What Fikret knows about Gamze will lead everyone to ruin.

title: Ateş
overview: Ateş from Cihangir and Yavuz from Tophaneli are two very close friends. Ateş dreams of becoming an actor, while Yavuz is a taxi driver who wants to avenge his brother's death from drugs. Ateş, who stands up against all the injustices he encounters and often gets into trouble because of it, sees his life completely change when he meets Aleyna, who has fled to Istanbul to escape being forced into marriage with someone her family doesn't approve of.

title: Geranium
overview: Just before her final exams, 19 years old Defne, has to return to her hometown after her father's stroke. His rehabilitation sessions will give the pair a chance to heal their fragile relationship in this beautiful Mediterranean town.

title: Mahalle
overview: There is a change when three friends living in the neighborhood continue their ordinary lives. The emergence of a mysterious stranger who has just moved to the neighborhood has also changed the life of the third.

title: Cumbadan Rumbaya
overview: Peyami Safa's novel Cumbadan Rumbaya features some of the most extraordinary characters in his works. It tells the story of Karagümrüklü Cemile, whose sole desire is to escape her dilapidated home and neighborhood and move into an apartment in Nişantaşı, where she hopes to find a wealthy husband.

title: Seaburners
overview: Denise, a botanist, is working in the swamps in a part of Turkey, planting and researching local flora. In her evenings she sometimes meets with her lover Hamit, a simple man at first glance. But he is making his living with human trafficking which he keeps a secret from Denise. When Hamit learns that Denise is being sent back to her home country soon, one final trafficking job takes a dark outcome.

title: Only You
overview: The passionate love between a former boxer and a beautiful blind woman.

title: Şahane Züğürtler
overview: Fikret is a wealthy cotton merchant. He married his childhood sweetheart Leyla and built a happy home. The young couple's kindness touched many people around them. However, one day, things took a turn for the worse. Fikret's business failed. Yusuf, whom he had once saved from bankruptcy, refused to help him. He was acting out of resentment that Leyla had chosen Fikret over him. Fikret is an honorable man. He has been appointed guardian of the young son of his closest friend, who died in a traffic accident. The management of a large fortune has fallen to him. However, he prefers to work as a servant in Istanbul rather than touch the money. The couple builds a new life for themselves in Istanbul. But Yusuf's resentment shows no signs of abating.

title: Firefly
overview: The road runner movie of two clever cheaters turns to a love story.

title: Kanun Adamı
overview: Murat, a lawyer, has a close friend named Kemal who is on trial for murder. Kemal, who has been undergoing treatment at a hospital for some time, confesses to the crime. However, Murat insists that Kemal did not commit the murder. He takes on his friend's defense and manages to have the trial postponed. Murat will try to prove his friend Kemal's innocence.

title: Bygones Be Bygones
overview: A mother's plan to find her bachelor son a match derails when a new prospect turns up and sinister schemes unfold.

title: Inflame
overview: Hasret has been seeing the same nightmare for some time, but she keeps living unaware that what she sees is actually remembering. A 30-year-old woman who works in a News Channel, living alone in the flat left by her musician parents who died in a car crash twenty years ago.  Is it?  The question creeps into her mind, and then (or maybe even before) her life through recurring nightmares: Is it possible that her parents did not die in a car crash?

title: The Stigma
overview: Tarik Akan plays a man who attempts to get revenge for the rape of his fiancee.

title: Eşrefpaşalı
overview: The film depicts Kudret's struggle against Ali Bey and his men, as he refuses to leave his neighborhood. Ali Bey, who has made a deal with the Americans, wants to build a factory in the Eşrefpaşa neighborhood. To do so, he must first evict the neighborhood's residents. Ali Bey recruits Hasan, the neighborhood's tough guy, to help him achieve his goal. Kudret, who refuses to leave the neighborhood, organizes the people against Ali Bey. However, Ali Bey lures Kudret's inner circle to his side with various promises. Left to fight alone, Kudret will face his friends one last time.

title: Sweet Nigar
overview: Easily deceived by her charming affectation, a boisterous country man kidnaps an adventurous damsel to a far off land hoping soon she will come to her senses with him. She lacks the courage to reject his straightforward endearment.

title: Yaz Bekârı
overview: Orhan, who works at a bank, has an unhappy marriage. His wife, Şermin, drinks constantly, gambles, and neglects her family. Orhan tries to keep his marriage going for the sake of his son. However, one day, after an argument with his wife, Şermin leaves home. After his wife leaves, Orhan meets Leyla, a singer. What begins as a simple fling turns into love for Orhan. However, being with Leyla will not be as easy as Orhan had imagined.

title: Gazelle
overview: Yakup, a Turkish music teacher seeking political asylum in New York, is trying to keep his head above water as he navigates the US immigration system. Working illegally in a restaurant kitchen with a lively group of fellow immigrants, he is laser focused on laying the groundwork to bring his wife and daughter abroad. In a desperate attempt to expedite the process, he seeks help from a group of shady fellow countrymen who resort to risky methods to get people out of Turkey. But things quickly go sideways and chances to reunite with his loved ones deteriorate by the minute.

title: Godspeed
overview: An ex-army captain travels to Dalyan to stop his friend's beloved from marrying another man, but grief and trauma from a combat tragedy mar his journey.

title: Gang of Women
overview: Two journalists in Beirut want to make exciting report for their newspaper, but can't find anything. They discover a gang that all the members are women and work in counterfeiting , so they search for its leader.

title: You Me Lenin
overview: One day waves bring a wooden statue of Lenin to a small town by the Black Sea. The statue is erected in the town square by the Municipality with the hope that it would attract tourists to the town. As an official opening ceremony is planned with the participation of the Prime Minister and a Russian delegation, the statue gets stolen. Two police investigators from Ankara are assigned to find Lenin in twelve hours. Townspeople give an unexpected answer to the question «Where is Lenin?».

title: Arım Balım Peteğim
overview: Daughter of a private eye falls in love with father’s playboy client. Pretending to have a busy love life, she makes him jealous and he also starts to love her. When father discovers the affair he asks the Playboy to leave his daughter not knowing she’s pregnant.
